chat_history.question: can you tell me about this project very shortly please
chat_history.answer: Sure! The project focuses on developing a modular AI assistant robot with a mobile platform that can move and communicate. It uses React.js for the web frontend, Gradio for prototyping, and potential Unity or a custom framework for the touchscreen display. The robot will integrate an LLM-based interactive system for natural language understanding and dynamic presentation generation.
